answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, unlocked only after continuous uptime, rewards vest against future work. What survives to the whisper is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Work waits on the bridge until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the anchor of the next round. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
